svg.title: A clinic, a laboratory, and the operator's own tenant
svg.desc: Above the deployment, two kinds of thing that are not inside it. Applications ask the store: the clinic's own application over FHIR, and a host that embeds the store in its own JVM, each carrying a token from that tenant's own issuer. Participants are offered work: a bench instrument behind a router and a supplier's own system elsewhere, each holding an enrolment and taking work it asked for. In the middle, one node running one process on one port, with a service set per tenant - the clinic, the laboratory, and the managing tenant holding what this deployment was told to serve - each with its own issuer and keys. Beneath, one database each, holding that tenant's records, history, trail and vault. Nothing crosses between the columns, for anybody, the operator included.

g.text: A CLINIC, A LABORATORY, AND THE OPERATOR'S OWN TENANT
the clinic's own application, over FHIR
a host that embeds the store in its JVM
a bench instrument, behind a router
a token from that tenant's own issuer
an enrolment, and work it asked for
one node — one process, one port
a connection handed to each, and never a credential the operator holds
what is not drawn because it does not exist: a read across the columns, for anybody
including the operator; a broker beside the databases; a call from the node outwards
